summary.text: Shawn McPherson is a Republican state representative who has represented Kentucky House of Representatives District 22 since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner, he previously worked with the Kentucky Department of Transportation and owned an appraisal business.

paragraphs.text: Shawn McPherson earned a B.S. and an M.S. in agriculture.
His career experience includes working with the Kentucky Department of Transportation and owning an appraisal business.
He took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2021, as the successor to Wilson Stone.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the House Agriculture, Appropriations and Revenue, and Banking and Insurance committees and the Tourism and Outdoor Recreation Committee.
The Republican primary for his seat on May 19, 2026, was canceled.
